core_obligations: Round low-entropy pseudodistributions while preserving conditional properties by eliminating global correlations.
Find dense subcubes with large shift-partition potential and combine partial assignments using the complete iteration argument.
Retain the author algorithm, complete rounding analysis and deferred expansion certificate.
difficulty_reason: The authors combine higher-degree sum-of-squares conditioning, global-correlation elimination and shift-partition rounding on restricted Johnson subgraphs. The low-completeness theorem adds a non-routine edge-covering argument to capture simultaneously satisfied edges.

dedup.scope: DOI and actual arXiv alias searched in full legacy/prepared snapshots with no same-source hit. Two author main results have different parameter guarantees: explicit near-one approximation versus arbitrary positive constant completeness requiring edge covering. They are not alternative proofs; shared supporting lemmas and generalization sketches are not counted.

compared.difference: Near-one theorem gives explicit noise/error soundness 2^{-O(sqrt(epsilon)/alpha)}; arbitrary-completeness theorem requires new edge-covering proof and guarantees constant soundness for every c>0.
